AA_CONTROL: A subset of control cells is re-run with the identical seed and arm. sampling_seed's docstring records a MEASURED 40% divergence under identical code when the seed is absent. If A/A is not byte-identical the residual nondeterminism is reported as a floor on any effect claim.

MISSING_VS_ZERO.missing: server failure, HTTP error, or a completion truncated by the token cap (stop_type=length). The cell is EXCLUDED and counted -- never scored 0.
MISSING_VS_ZERO.zero: the model returned a complete response whose code does not import or whose engine raises. That is a real failure of the treatment and scores 0.0.

PRIMARY.clustering: GAME, not attempt. Replicates within a game are averaged into ONE per-game mean before pairing -- 24 games x 3 replicates is 24 independent units, not 72. Treating replicates as trials inflated a p from 0.125 to 0.049 on 2026-07-31 and had to be corrected.
PRIMARY.test: exact two-sided paired sign test over GAMES (ties dropped)
PRIMARY.why: results/arc_metric_headroom_20260801/metric_headroom.json searched 13 metrics and recommended it as the only one with headroom that does not reward inertness; exp6018's primary (exact-match) floored at 0.0 in both arms

SECONDARIES_reported_not_primary: accuracy (exact-full-grid) -- exp6018's floored primary, reported as the control
STOPPING_RULE: every roster game x both arms x N replicates, or the wall budget. Analysis is run ONCE, after collection stops. No peeking-and-extending.

generator.seed_scheme: CARNOT_ARC_GENERATOR_SEED = SEED_BASE + replicate; the SAME seed in both arms of a (game, replicate) pair. sampling_seed() then emits seed*1000+attempt so the retry ladder stays distinct.
generator.why_not_the_exp6018_model: exp6018 ran Qwen3.5-9B-MTP, RETIRED by the 2026-07-28 operator directive. Measuring the flag on a retired generator would not inform a live-path decision.

multiplicity: One primary. The six secondaries are exploratory; a p<0.05 on any of them reads against a Bonferroni threshold of 0.00833, and means 'worth one confirmatory run', not 'established'.
not_submitted: no scored or online ARC game is played; submission is operator-only
question: Does CARNOT_ARC_OBJECT_PERCEPTION=1 improve held-out world-model induction quality on the CURRENT live generator?

roster_amendment.original_rule: heldout tail has >=1 CHANGING transition (grid-change only)
roster_amendment.why_it_was_wrong: WorldModelVerifier.score `continue`s on rows where level_after > level_before before incrementing n_changing. Every window straddles exactly one level-up and it always lands in the tail, so a game whose tail IS that row grades nothing and returns change_fidelity 0.0 for every engine in BOTH arms -- exp6018's instrument floor, re-created per game inside the experiment written to escape it.

roster_rule: builds a progress window AND its held-out tail has >=1 VERIFIER-GRADABLE changing transition (grid changes AND the row is not the level-up, which WorldModelVerifier.score excludes) AND leak-free (no held-out transition line in the prompt, none textually identical to a shown one).
roster_sensitivity_rule: heldout_gradable_changing >= 3, so a per-game mean is not carried by one or two transitions
treatment_witness: For every game, `on` minus the OBJECT STRUCTURE block must be BYTE-EQUAL to `off`. Verified before the first LLM call.
